verses.en: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
verses.pt: Clama agora! Haverá alguém que te responda? E a qual dos santos te voltarás?
verses.en_web: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
verses.en_bbe: Give now a cry for help; is there anyone who will give you an answer? and to which of the holy ones will you make your prayer?

verses.en: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.pt: Pois a ira acaba com o louco, e o zelo mata o tolo.
verses.en_web: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
verses.en_bbe: For wrath is the cause of death to the foolish, and he who has no wisdom comes to his end through passion.

verses.en: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.pt: Eu vi ao louco lançar raízes, porém logo amaldiçoei sua habitação.
verses.en_web: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.en_bbe: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly the curse came on his house.

verses.en: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
verses.pt: Seus filhos estarão longe da salvação; na porta são despedaçados, e não há quem os livre.
verses.en_web: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
verses.en_bbe: Now his children have no safe place, and they are crushed before the judges, for no one takes up their cause.

verses.en: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.pt: O faminto devora sua colheita, e a tira até dentre os espinhos; e o assaltante traga sua riqueza.
verses.en_web: whose harvest the hungry eats up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
verses.en_bbe: Their produce is taken by him who has no food, and their grain goes to the poor, and he who is in need of water gets it from their spring.

verses.en: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.pt: Porque a aflição não procede do pó da terra, nem a opressão brota do chão.
verses.en_web: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.en_bbe: For evil does not come out of the dust, or trouble out of the earth;

verses.en: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.pt: Mas o ser humano nasce para a opressão, assim como as faíscas das brasas se levantam a voar.
verses.en_web: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.en_bbe: But trouble is man's fate from birth, as the flames go up from the fire.

verses.en: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
verses.pt: Porém eu buscaria a Deus, e a ele confiaria minha causa;
verses.en_web: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
verses.en_bbe: But as for me, I would make my prayer to God, and I would put my cause before him:

verses.en: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.pt: Pois ele é o que faz coisas grandiosas e incompreensíveis, e inúmeras maravilhas.
verses.en_web: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
verses.en_bbe: Who does great things outside our knowledge, wonders without number:

verses.en: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
verses.pt: Ele é o que dá a chuva sobre a face da terra, e envia águas sobre os campos.
verses.en_web: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;
verses.en_bbe: Who gives rain on the earth, and sends water on the fields:

verses.en: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.pt: Ele põe os humildes em lugares altos, para que os sofredores sejam postos em segurança.
verses.en_web: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
verses.en_bbe: Lifting up those who are low, and putting the sad in a safe place;

verses.en: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
verses.pt: Ele frustra os planos dos astutos, para que suas mãos nada consigam executar.
verses.en_web: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
verses.en_bbe: Who makes the designs of the wise go wrong, so that they are unable to give effect to their purposes.

verses.en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.pt: Ele prende aos sábios em sua própria astúcia; para que o conselho dos perversos seja derrubado.
verses.en_web: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
verses.en_bbe: He takes the wise in their secret designs, and the purposes of the twisted are cut off suddenly.

verses.en: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.pt: De dia eles se encontram com as trevas, e ao meio-dia andam apalpando como de noite.
verses.en_web: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.
verses.en_bbe: In the daytime it becomes dark for them, and in the sunlight they go feeling about as if it was night.

verses.en: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.pt: Porém livra ao necessitado da espada de suas bocas, e da mão do violento.
verses.en_web: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.
verses.en_bbe: But he keeps safe from their sword those who have no father, and the poor from the power of the strong.

verses.en: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.pt: Pois ele é esperança para o necessitado, e a injustiça tapa sua boca.
verses.en_web: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.
verses.en_bbe: So the poor man has hope, and the mouth of the evil-doer is stopped.

verses.en: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.pt: Eis que bem-aventurado é o homem a quem Deus corrige; portanto não rejeites o castigo do Todo-Poderoso.
verses.en_web: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, that man is happy who has training from the hand of God: so do not let your heart be shut to the teaching of the Ruler of all.

verses.en: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.pt: Pois ele faz a chaga, mas também põe o curativo; ele fere, mas suas mãos curam.
verses.en_web: For he wounds, and binds up. He injures, and his hands make whole.
verses.en_bbe: For after his punishment he gives comfort, and after wounding, his hands make you well.

verses.en: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.pt: Em seis angústias ele te livrará, e em sete o mal não te tocará.
verses.en_web: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil shall touch you.
verses.en_bbe: He will keep you safe from six troubles, and in seven no evil will come near you.

verses.en: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.pt: Na fome ele te livrará da morte, e na guerra livrará do poder da espada.
verses.en_web: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.
verses.en_bbe: When there is need of food he will keep you from death, and in war from the power of the sword.

verses.en: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.pt: Do açoite da língua estarás encoberto; e não temerás a destruição quando ela vier.
verses.en_web: You shall be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither shall you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
verses.en_bbe: He will keep you safe from the evil tongue; and you will have no fear of wasting when it comes.

verses.en: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.pt: Tu rirás da destruição e da fome, e não temerás os animais da terra.
verses.en_web: At destruction and famine you shall laugh, neither shall you be afraid of the animals of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: You will make sport of destruction and need, and will have no fear of the beasts of the earth.

verses.en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.pt: Pois até com as pedras do campo terás teu pacto, e os animais do campo serão pacíficos contigo.
verses.en_web: For you shall be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field shall be at peace with you.
verses.en_bbe: For you will be in agreement with the stones of the earth, and the beasts of the field will be at peace with you.

verses.en: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
verses.pt: E saberás que há paz em tua tenda; e visitarás tua habitação, e não falharás.
verses.en_web: You shall know that your tent is in peace. You shall visit your fold, and shall miss nothing.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be certain that your tent is at peace, and after looking over your property you will see that nothing is gone.

verses.en: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.pt: Também saberás que tua semente se multiplicará, e teus descendentes serão como a erva da terra.
verses.en_web: You shall know also that your offspring shall be great, Your offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: You will be certain that your seed will be great, and your offspring like the plants of the earth.

verses.en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
verses.pt: Na velhice virás à sepultura, como o amontoado de trigo que se recolhe a seu tempo.
verses.en_web: You shall come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
verses.en_bbe: You will come to your last resting-place in full strength, as the grain is taken up to the crushing-floor in its time.

verses.en: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
verses.pt: Eis que é isto o que temos constatado, e assim é; ouve-o, e pensa nisso tu para teu bem.
verses.en_web: Look this, we have searched it, so it is. Hear it, and know it for your good.”
verses.en_bbe: See, we have made search with care, and it is so; it has come to our ears; see that you take note of it for yourself.
